tagline: Starting on or after January 15, 2027, with ANSI mode enabled in Databricks Runtime 19 and above, array contains(arr, value) will return NULL, not false, when arr is a constant empty array and value…
what_it_does: Starting on or after January 15, 2027, with ANSI mode enabled in Databricks Runtime 19 and above, array contains(arr, value) will return NULL, not false, when arr is a constant empty array and value is NULL. map contains key(map, key) with a constant empty map will change the same way. As a result, NOT array contains(arr, value) will no longer match rows where value is NULL.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
